_comment: Copy to ~/.config/armamentarium/dock.json. 'path_map' rewrites stale mount roots in a session's userSelectedFolders (and cwd) when docking it onto this machine (keys matched longest-first). 'source_dirs' are directories `armamentarium list` scans for dockable sessions. 'roaming_store' is the shared directory holding the checkout ledger and undocked sessions.
